correctness.rationale: For each isolated tagged vertex, all n-1 others are conditionally independent uniform points on its complementary arc. This yields exact conditional edge probability p(r) and a complete mixed-moment identity. The quadratic branch has one interior root for n>=6 and the linear branch exactly one further root; discriminants exclude positive regions for n<=5. Explicit Taylor expansion gives the sparse limiting covariance. Independent rational-grid identity checks and direct random-graph simulations passed. No use of numerical checks as proof.
